{{Quotation|[[Tahnnakai Temple]] plaque|Jaizhanju was an exceptionally tall and very strong young [[Warrior]] who lived over three hundred years ago. Orphaned at birth and self-trained, Jaizhanju traveled [[Cantha]] and single-handedly defeated bands of monsters that threatened villages all over the countryside. When the [[Canthan Emperor|emperor]] invited her to visit him in the [[Forbidden City]] so he could reward her, she arrived days late, having stopped to defend an orphanage from a [[skale]] invasion. Standing before the emperor's throne, she refused his proffered reward, and instead offered her sword and her life in exchange for the insult of tardiness. The bemused emperor refused her offer, and Jaizhanju continued to defend the weak until her death five years later, by which time legends numbered her kills in the tens of thousands. The emperor himself petitioned the Oracle to give her a place in the Tahnnakai Temple, and so it was.}}

[[Jaizhanju]] is one of several [[Canthan Heroes]] whose spirit dwells in the [[Tahnnakai Temple]], giving advice to those who seek it.
{{spoiler|''[[Guild Wars Factions]]''}}
When [[Shiro Tagachi]] returned in 1072 <small>[[Mouvelian calendar|AE]]</small>, Jaizhanju was bound within one of Shiro's soul binders during his attack on the temple, making her a [[bound spirit]]. However she was eventually freed from the [[Bound Jaizhanju]] through the action of [[Master Togo]], [[Mhenlo]] and others, and later offered her insight in how to defeat the Betrayer.

==Dialogue==
[[Image:Jaizhanju statue.jpg|right|150px|thumb|Jaizhanju's statue in the temple]]

'''During [[Tahnnakai Temple]]:'''
:''"I dishonored myself only once while I lived, and that was by choice. Never have I allowed evil to control my actions, and I will not begin today!"''

'''After [[Tahnnakai Temple]]:'''
:''"Thank you for rescuing me. If I could, I would offer you my sword to assist you in your task. In its stead, I offer you this advice: [[Echovald Forest]] is a dangerous place. Beware the [[Warden]]s; they no longer serve to protect the forest."''

'''After [[Arborstone]]:'''
:''"Your inner strength shows through in your actions. I thought we might meet again. If it is the Jade Sea you seek, beware of the dangerous Naga. They serve no one but themselves, and they hunt the borders of the sea islands with a vigorous fervor."''

'''After [[Boreas Seabed]]:'''
:''"With spear and urn in hand, travel safely toward the Sunjiang District. Shiro awaits you, as does your destiny."''

'''After [[Sunjiang District]]:'''
:''"Remember, defeat is temporary, heroism is eternal. You must not let Shiro destroy Cantha. I may have left your world, but Cantha is still my home."''

'''After [[The Eternal Grove]]:'''
:''"Shiro was defeated two hundred years ago when a Canthan, a Kurzick, and a Luxon used their talents together... It was wise to seek out the Kurzicks and gain their assistance. Utilize their friendship to gain access to the Unwaking Waters."''

'''After [[Gyala Hatchery]]:'''
:''"The Luxons are a powerful people. With their strength behind you, you can enter the Unwaking Waters and seek out the powerful dragon known as Kuunavang."''

'''After [[Unwaking Waters]]:'''
:''"With the power granted to you by Kuunavang, you must now save the emperor. Go to his palace and stop Shiro before it is too late!"''

'''After [[Raisu Palace]]:'''
:''"Togo died protecting the emperor, and as long as our emperor lives, the people of Cantha will continue to hold out hope. Shiro is more powerful now, but he is also mortal. Show him what mortality means...."''

'''After [[Imperial Sanctum]]:'''
:''"Despite my words, I was beginning to think all was lost. You have proved me wrong. You honor all of the heroes of Cantha's past with your deeds this day."''

==Notes==
*The skill [[Jaizhenju Strike]] is named after her.
*Jaizhanju is clearly a Canthan name, yet her spirit form seems to be wearing Ascalonian clothing.
